objective: Route the token from S to G using the current environment.

C0.text: Route the token from S to G. Return exactly one JSON object with one field named implementation whose value is an array of node labels.

C1.text: The graph uses symbolic node labels. Return exactly one JSON object with one field named implementation whose value is an array of node labels.

context_footprint_control: Character counts are frozen but not treated as token equality. Concrete token counts must be measured and recorded at execution.

environment_boundary.e1: E_tilde=E1 and E_eval=E1; the A->B edge is absent from the current graph
environment_boundary.stimulus_requirement: e0 and e1 must produce different model-visible rendered inputs
environment_boundary.anti_leakage: the model-visible input exposes the current graph/state but does not contain a textual instruction naming the removed edge or suggesting either valid alternative

interventions.e1: Perturbed environment assignment: current graph omits A->B.

raw_output_custody: raw_model_output is primary custody object and is never human-rewritten
raw_input_custody: rendered_input is preserved exactly; input_hash binds it to the TrialSpec
session_control: fresh_independent_trial; each replication starts without prior conversation history

identity.observation_hash: SHA-256(canonical TrialSpec + raw_model_output + derived evaluation record)

factorial_design.assignment: deterministic domain-separated SHA-256 seed per cell and replicate, followed by deterministic sort

budget.measurement: actual provider-reported input/output tokens, turns, tool calls, and latency are recorded when available
budget.violation: execution exceeding the declared budget is invalid or explicitly flagged; it is not silently normalized

analysis_order: preserve rendered input and raw output
calculate the distribution-valued context x intervention interaction
claim_ceiling: The frozen assay plus trial contract defines an observable environment stimulus and auditable four-cell execution. It makes no claim that a context effect exists.
